signals.text: Revenue grew 24% a year over 3 years vs 26% over 5: growth is steady.
Profit compounded at 18% vs revenue at 24%: profits are lagging sales.
Operating margin expanded 9 bps in 3 years (18.8% → 18.9%).
Borrowings grew 2.9x in 3 years while equity grew 2.1x: growth is being funded with debt.
Working-capital days shortened by 46 days in 3 years (-28 → -74).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 165% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

flags.text: Profit compounded at 18% vs revenue at 24%: profits are lagging sales.
Borrowings grew 2.9x in 3 years while equity grew 2.1x: growth is being funded with debt.

guidance.statement: H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4.
guidance.quote: During the outlook, we have just mentioned that H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4

guidance.statement: Medium-term outlook aims to achieve 22% to 24% by FY29.
guidance.quote: During the Analyst Day, you spoke about an aspiration of achieving 22% to 24% by FY '29. That aspiration can still hold?

guidance.statement: Commercial vehicles will return to growth next quarter.
guidance.quote: On the commercial vehicle, we will be on for growth next quarter.

delivered.statement: Year-on-year Constant Currency revenue growth was 0.1%, with a USD revenue decline of 0.6%.
Quarter-on-quarter Constant Currency revenue declined by 3.6%.
EBITDA was at 17.2%, EBIT at 12.3%, and PAT at INR 1.17 billion.
KPIT secured USD 257 million worth of deal wins during the quarter.

calls.tone: Cautious on near-term European headwinds and timing, but confident in medium-term growth drivers.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the timing of European OEM recovery and impact of client budget cuts.
Skepticism over rising other expenses and the timeline to return to normal margins.
Questions on commercial vehicle weakness and the status of ramped-down SDV programs.
Discrepancy in revenue growth rates between strategic clients and reported segment numbers.

business.summary: KPIT Technologies is a global technology company specializing in embedded software solutions, AI platforms, and product engineering for automotive and mobility OEMs.

segments.name: Passenger Cars and Commercial Vehicles / Mobility
segments.note: Software and product engineering solutions for automotive.

guidance.statement: Expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solution and products.
guidance.quote: We expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solution and products, and we hope it will increase over the period.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin expected between 20.5% to 21.2% for FY27.
guidance.quote: EBITDA 20.5 to 21.2 post increasing investment in AI solutions and products competency development and new markets.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin expected to increase to between 22% to 24% in the medium term.
guidance.quote: we expect the EBITDA to be between 22% to 24% from where we are today.

guidance.statement: Solutions and products revenue share to reach 50% in the medium term.
guidance.quote: 50% revenue share to be achieved from solutions and product.

guidance.statement: Targeting annualized sustainable double-digit growth in the medium term.
guidance.quote: We have opportunity for annualized sustainable double-digit growth.

delivered.statement: Q4 constant currency revenue grew by 1.8% and dollar revenue grew by 1.9% quarter-on-quarter.
Closed $349 million worth of deal increments during the quarter.
EBITDA margin for the year stood at 20.8% and for the quarter at 20.6%.
Trucks and off-highway segment grew 18% year-on-year, with Q4 growth of 11.6%.

calls.tone: confident on long-term strategy, AI-led transformation and pipeline, despite near-term macro headwinds and program delays.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned how legacy OEM focused KPIT can leverage AD/ADAS spends primarily happening with new-age OEMs.
Pushed on how KPIT can expand EBITDA margins while competing with aggressive Chinese ER&D specialists operating at high gross margins and negative EBITDA.
Inquired about Japanese OEMs losing mojo/market share and the impact of program cancellations from Japanese clients.
Sought clarification on whether large program ramp downs were planned or unexpected, and if other projects face similar risks.

guidance.statement: Growth in Q4 FY26 will be higher and the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
guidance.quote: One is, we believe that in the last quarter that is Q4, we will improve, our growth will be higher, it will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.

guidance.statement: Profitability will improve in Q4 compared to Q3 despite ongoing investments.
guidance.quote: And our profitability will improve from what we have in Q3 in spite of our investments.

guidance.statement: The company will grow next year at a higher rate than the current year.
guidance.quote: We will for sure grow next year higher than this year. And we believe that we will be in a position to do it.

guidance.statement: A large part of the business may take 12 to 18 months to convert into solutions.
guidance.quote: We do believe that this may take 12 months to 18 months, for a large part of our business to convert into this

guidance.statement: Certain AI and specific solutions will start contributing in the next 3 to 4 months.
guidance.quote: specifically AI and some of the few solutions which we believe have potential would start in the next 3 months to 4 months.

guidance.statement: Margins will remain in the current ballpark next year and improve in the medium term.
guidance.quote: We will be in a position to be in the ballpark of the margins we have, little here and there, but similar margins in spite of the investment. But in the midterm, we are very sure that the margins will improve.

delivered.statement: FY26 year-on-year growth was 9.4% in rupee terms and 3% in US Dollar terms.
Constant currency growth in Quarter 3 was 1.5% with negative organic growth under 1%.
Net profit excluding the one-time Labor Code impact was INR 1.53 billion.
The TCV value of deals won during the quarter was INR 202 million.
The fixed price revenue mix reached 66% compared to 59% last year.
Cash at the end of the quarter stood at about INR 9 billion.

calls.tone: Cautious on near-term macro and organic growth, but confident about strategic pivot to solutions, AI, and medium-term growth.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether the shift to solutions-led model would cannibalize existing revenue.
Analysts pressed on why earlier optimism on H2 has not fully reflected in Q3 margins and growth.
Skepticism around declining revenues in Asia and the trajectory of large client programs in Japan.
Questions raised on past failures of IT-approaches and what makes AI solutions adoptable now.

guidance.statement: Maintain 21% EBITDA for the full year despite upcoming increments.
guidance.quote: we are very confident that what we have talked about, that we will be in a position to maintain 21% EBITDA for the full year.

guidance.statement: Quarter 3 will have flattish to positive organic constant currency growth.
guidance.quote: we believe that in the Quarter 3, we will be in a position to have a flattish to positive organic constant currency growth

guidance.statement: Quarter 4 will see a meaningful growth coming in.
guidance.quote: In terms of Quarter 4, we do believe that there will be a meaningful growth, which will be coming in.

delivered.statement: Year-on-year dollar revenue grew 4.4% and constant currency grew 0.4%.
Quarter-on-quarter growth was 1.8% in dollar terms and 0.3% in constant currency.
EBITDA margin stood at 21.1% for the quarter.
Profit from fully owned business increased from INR 177 crore to INR 191.8 crore.
Net employee addition was around 300 people, including 800 from Caresoft.
Net cash stands at around Rs. 10.5 billion.

calls.tone: confident on solutions and demand revival, cautious on near-term headwinds

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned why strong deal wins are not reflecting in revenue growth.
Scepticism regarding higher share of losses from startups like Qorix and N-Dream.
Concerns on impact of OEM delays in EV and architecture programs on KPIT.

guidance.statement: Profitability may remain within a narrow range in the near-term due to continued investments.
guidance.quote: profitability may remain within a narrow range in the near-term, but we believe these investments are essential

guidance.statement: Targeting completion of AI deployment across existing projects categorized by priority by Q2 of upcoming year.
guidance.quote: deployment targeted for completion by Q2 of the upcoming year.

guidance.statement: Aiming to achieve a 30% reduction in direct and indirect emissions (Scopes 1 and 2) by 2030.
guidance.quote: aimed at achieving a 30% reduction in direct and indirect emissions (Scopes 1 and 2) by 2030.

delivered.statement: Consolidated revenue grew 10.49% to INR 64,549.31 million and 4.83% in USD terms to USD 724.80 million.
Consolidated net profit after tax stood at INR 6,373.70 million.
EBITDA margin remained strong at 20.8%.

calls.tone: Resilient and forward-looking, acknowledging near-term industry disruptions while maintaining confidence in long-term technology-led growth.

business.summary: KPIT Technologies is an independent software and systems integration partner specializing in mobility and automotive engineering, helping OEMs transition towards software-defined vehicles and AI-led engineering.
